text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's ruling ZANU-PF party says it is worried abut increasing poverty in the country while the economy grows, and will be taking the driving seat in the battle to open up opportunities to the poor.

- Tougher laws to make Zimbabwe's roads safer, with mandatory jail terms for many offences involving drivers of commuter buses and heavy vehicles will be on the statute books if parliament passes proposed changes to the law.
- United Bottlers' Harare plant will soon become the largest bottling production line in central Africa following an injection of Z$35 million to enable production of 42,000 bottles per hour.
